definitions.explanation: A powerful wind that can cause disruption or damage. Commonly used in weather reports and news.

examples.japanese: {強風|きょうふう}で{傘|かさ}が{壊|こわ}れた。
examples.english: My umbrella broke in the strong wind.

examples.japanese: {強風|きょうふう}のため、{電車|でんしゃ}が{運休|うんきゅう}になった。
examples.english: Trains were suspended due to strong winds.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}の{影響|えいきょう}で{強風|きょうふう}が{吹|ふ}き{荒|あ}れ、{各地|かくち}で{被害|ひがい}が{出|で}た。
examples.english: Strong winds raged due to the typhoon, causing damage in various areas.

notes:
USAGE:
{強風|きょうふう} is a compound of {強|きょう} (strong) and {風|ふう} (wind). It is frequently used in weather forecasts and transportation announcements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {強風|きょうふう}が{吹|ふ}く (strong winds blow)
- {強風|きょうふう}{注意報|ちゅういほう} (strong wind advisory)
- {強風|きょうふう}のため (due to strong winds)
- {強風|きょうふう}に{煽|あお}られる (to be buffeted by strong winds)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {強風|きょうふう}: strong wind (neutral, weather term)
- {暴風|ぼうふう}: violent wind, storm-force wind (more extreme)
- {突風|とっぷう}: gust of wind (sudden, brief)
- {微風|びふう}: gentle breeze (opposite end of scale)
